title: Embedding base steps into extended steps
statement: Let $P$ be a program of ordinary instructions, let $c$ be a configuration for words of width $W$, let $o$ be an output string, and let $r$ be a natural number. If every instruction of $P$ is regarded as a base instruction in the extended instruction set, then one extended step on the configuration with memory and program counter from $c$, output $o$, and count $r$ is the ordinary step on $c$, mapped so that any resulting configuration retains output $o$ and count $r$, while any accept or reject result is unchanged. The input string and coin string do not affect this step.
hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a list of ordinary instructions
The input and coin strings are arbitrary Boolean lists
